title: 見面與介紹
subtitle: Meeting & Introductions
focus: be 動詞（am/is/are）、人稱代名詞、問句與否定句

grammarWeek.explain: be 動詞（am/is/are）會依主詞不同而改變：I 用 am，He/She/It 用 is，You/We/They 用 are。否定句只要在 be 動詞後面加上 not（is not 可縮寫成 isn't，are not 可縮寫成 aren't），疑問句則是把 be 動詞移到句子最前面，再加上主詞。
patterns: I am a student.
She is not a teacher. (She isn't a teacher.)
Are you from Taiwan?
They are not busy. (They aren't busy.)

grammarWeek.explain: 所有格（my、your、his、her、our、their）放在名詞前面，用來表示東西或家人是「誰的」，例如 my mother（我的媽媽）。動詞 have 用在 I、You、We、They 之後，has 用在 He、She 之後，用來表示「擁有」某位家人或某樣東西。this、that、these、those 用來指出人或物，this/that 接單數，these/those 接複數。

Do you go to work by bus?
He usually eats breakfast at home, but he never eats breakfast on Sundays.

title: 地方與方位

grammarWeek.point: There is / There are + 地方介系詞
grammarWeek.explain: 「There is」用來表示某個地方「有」一個單數的人或物，「There are」則用於複數。否定句是在 is/are 後面加 not（isn't / aren't），疑問句則把 Is/There 或 Are/There 的順序對調，變成 Is there...? / Are there...?。地方介系詞（in, on, under, next to, between, near 等）用來說明東西或地方確切的位置。

There are two chairs next to the table.
There isn't a car in the garage.
Is there a park near your house?

grammarWeek.explain: 英文名詞分為可數名詞（countable，如 apple, egg，有單數與複數形式）與不可數名詞（uncountable，如 water, rice，沒有複數形式）。在肯定句與提出邀請時，我們常用 some（一些）；在否定句與疑問句中，則常用 any。要禮貌地表達「我想要」時，可以用 would like 加上名詞，例如 I would like some coffee.；詢問不可數名詞的數量用 How much，詢問可數名詞的數量則用 How many。
patterns: I would like some bread.
Do you have any milk?
How much water do you want?
How many apples do you have?

grammarWeek.explain: 過去簡單式用來說已經發生的事。be動詞用 was/were，一般動詞規則變化加 -ed，但很多常用動詞是不規則變化，要直接背下來。否定句用 didn't + 原形動詞，問句用 Did + 主詞 + 原形動詞，注意動詞要用原形，不能再加 -ed。
patterns: I was tired last night.
She watched TV yesterday.
He didn't go to school last week.
Did you eat breakfast this morning?

readings.text: Last Saturday was a busy day for me. In the morning I was at the market with my mother. The market was very crowded, and the fruit was fresh and cheap. At noon we were at a small noodle shop near my house. The soup was hot and delicious. In the afternoon my brother was at home, but he was not happy. He was tired because his test was hard. In the evening we were all at my grandmother's house. The food was great, and everyone was happy.

On Mondays we were always tired, because our first class was at seven o'clock. On Fridays we were happy. After class we were often at a coffee shop near the school. The coffee was cheap and the cake was good. Last month I was in Taichung again, and the coffee shop was still there.

The music was loud, but nobody was angry. At night I was tired but happy. It was a wonderful day for me.

title: 未來計畫與能力
subtitle: Future Plans & Can
focus: be going to（未來計畫）、can/can't（能力）、邀約用語

grammarWeek.explain: 「be going to + 原形動詞」用來表達已經決定的未來計畫，例如 I am going to study tomorrow.；「can / can't + 原形動詞」用來表達能力，說明會不會做某件事，例如 I can swim, but I can't ski.；邀約時可以用「Would you like to + 原形動詞?」有禮貌地詢問對方意願。
patterns: I am going to visit my parents next week.
She can speak English, but she can't speak French.
Would you like to come to my party on Saturday?
We are going to go hiking if the weather is sunny.

writings.prompt: 這是本階段最後的寫作練習：請寫一篇 6-8 句的短文，自我介紹你自己，內容包含：你是誰、你的家人、你平常的生活、你上個月/上週做過的一件事、還有你下個月的計畫。盡量用到這 8 週學過的不同文法。
writings.sample: Hello, my name is Wei. I am from Taiwan, and I work at a small company. I have one brother and one sister. I usually wake up at seven and go to work at nine. Last month, I visited my grandparents in Tainan, and we had a wonderful time together. I can cook simple food, but I can't cook big meals yet. Next month, I am going to start learning English more seriously because I want to study abroad. I am excited and a little nervous, but I am ready for this new chapter.

writings.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文：介紹你的工作（或你想做的工作），並使用 and / but / because。
writings.sample: I am an office worker in Taipei. I like my job, because my boss is kind. The work is busy, but it is interesting. I go to work by MRT and I come home at seven. I would like to be a manager one day.

writings.prompt: 寫 3-5 句英文：描述一次讓你緊張或興奮的經驗（請使用過去簡單式和情緒形容詞）。
writings.sample: Last month I had my first English test. I was very nervous in the morning. My teacher was kind, so I felt better. I got a good score and my family was proud of me. I was excited all day.

writings.prompt: 期末總複習任務：寫 6-8 句英文自我介紹，內容要包含你是誰、你的家人、你的日常作息、你上個月做了什麼，以及你下個月的計畫。
writings.sample: Hello, my name is Ivy Lin and I am from Taichung. I work in a small hospital and I am a nurse. I have a husband and one son, and my son is six years old. My mother lives with us and she cooks dinner every evening. I get up at six o'clock and I go to work by scooter. I usually finish work at five, but on Friday I am very busy. Last month I visited my sister in Kaohsiung and we went to the beach together. Next month I am going to study English at night, because I would like to work in another country.

selfCheck: 我能用簡單句子自我介紹（姓名、國籍、職業）
我能描述我的家人和他們的樣子/個性
我能說出我每天的作息，並用頻率副詞（usually/sometimes/never）描述習慣
我能描述我家裡有哪些房間、東西在哪裡（there is/are + 介系詞）
我能在商店或餐廳簡單詢問價錢、點餐、買東西（some/any/would like）
我能簡單描述昨天或上週做過的事（過去簡單式）
我能說出我的未來計畫，以及我會不會做某件事（going to / can）
我能問路、給簡單的方向指示
我能看懂簡單短文並回答問題，聽懂簡單的英文句子並拼寫出來
我能寫一段 5 句以上、包含多種時態的英文短文
